about_the_game:
2044. A coastal megacity on the brink

Corporations run the city, and you - an engineer - lead a squad through battles and shifting alliances. Your father's disappearance exposes the secrets of the Resistance, the Order of Knights, and Prospect. Who to trust, what to risk - your choices reshape districts, prices, patrols, and events.

Tactical combat rewards planning: cover, lines of sight, AP economy, and squad role synergy. Smoke screens, EMP grenades, special ammo, and stimulants help you control the field. Set the tempo, seize initiative with overwatch, and chain abilities into squad combos.

8 archetypes: shooter, medic, mechanic, pyromaniac, hacker, survivor, runner, masochist.

Attributes for your tactics: vitality, perception, agility, reflexes, intellect, strength.

You won't be a generalist - choose your role.

Cobalt-chrome and composites workshop: design weapon prototypes, flash implants, experiment with mods.

Balance risk and reward; acquire rare components via contracts, trade, and salvaging.

A chill rooftop, port warehouses, a panoramic boulevard, and underground catacombs - each location has its own rhythm. Contracts and alliances change available missions, routes, vendors, and events. The Resistance, the Order, and Prospect pull you into their games - your decisions shape the city's future.

  • Turn-based tactics - grid, cover, lines of sight, overwatch, manage AP

  • Builds via implants and mods - body + weapons + software, no rigid classes

  • Reactive world - contracts and alliances change missions, routes, vendors, and events

  • Cyberpunk locations - chill rooftop, port, factories, catacombs, panoramic boulevard

  • Events with consequences - resource costs, betrayal, risks that save or break a plan

Roadmap

  • Netrunning (network) - interact with the environment in combat: traps, terminals, drones, cameras, mechanisms

  • Dynamic city reaction - reinforcements and tactics adapt to your style

  • Squad base - personal rooms, workbenches, upgrades that affect missions

  • New districts - port, Dark Quarter, panoramic boulevard with unique events

  • Crafting and mods - full implant crafting, weapon modifications, rare materials

  • Additional story branches - quests, characters, faction consequences

Early Access

Humanity Echo is in development - we ship content updates and balance patches with the community.

The demo currently includes:

  • Story prologue - first campaign missions with choice-driven branches

  • Tactical combat across districts - cover, lines of sight, AP, item use (smoke, grenades, medkits, buffs)

  • 8 background choices - early hooks for build ideas

  • Inventory and early locations

  • Quest journal and basic city events

From the developers

We are an indie team from Ukraine. We love tactical RPGs and are building a warm cyberpunk about people, choices, and responsibility. Your feedback directly influences our priorities.

💬 Discord - discuss mechanics, vote on updates, test features first.

💾 Add to wishlist - get notifications about updates, the demo, and launch discounts.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 — NVIDIA 470+ / RX 460 — Mesa 21.2+ / Intel Iris Xe — Mesa 21.2+
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 (NVIDIA 535+) / RX 580 (Mesa 23+), Vulkan 1.1
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
